'''Baarak Kalaim''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and the main [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] for the [[The Shield]]'s vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. He was also secretly a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative.

==Biography==
Baarak Kalaim worked for several outlaw techs before meeting [[Peert Ginzork]]. Ginzork hired Kalaim to be the main [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] for [[The Shield]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. He was also secretly a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative. He would spend his time tinkering with the engines and systems of the Shield's vehicles.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Kalaim was skilled but often absent-minded. He tended to talk to himself and was so unkempt that the other members of the Shield would avoid his quarters for fear of getting lost in the clutter.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Kalaim was skilled at all forms of repair, including [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Computer/Legends|computers]], [[Transport/Legends|transports]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weaponry.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Kalaim carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[pocket computer]], a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] and various tools.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baarak Kalaim was designed by [[Rick Olshak]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
